claims: Assess and manage respiratory status given spontaneous breathing on CPAP/PSV with recent arterial blood gas showing pH 7.32 and pCO2 46 mmHg; monitor ABG trends and consider adjustments to ventilatory support.
Monitor blood glucose closely given insulin infusion and fingerstick glucose of 144 mg/dL; adjust insulin drip per protocol.
Continue telemetry and temporary pacemaker monitoring given presence of temporary pacemaker wires and rate set at 52 bpm.
Monitor electrolytes and renal function given potassium 4.5 mEq/L, sodium 134 mEq/L, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL; recheck as clinically indicated.
Assess and manage pain with available analgesics (e.g., acetaminophen, oxycodone-acetaminophen) given reported mild pain.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with ranitidine as ordered.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as ordered (e.g., sequential compression devices or pharmacologic if prescribed).
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and oral care with chlorhexidine rinse to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
Mobilize patient as tolerated given bed rest status and full strength, to prevent complications of immobility.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit given anemia (hemoglobin 10.3-13.1 g/dL) and hemodynamic status.
